label: Intel NUC 13 Pro mini PC
description: 4x4-inch 13th-gen Core mini PC with a single Intel i226-V 2.5GbE port plus Intel AX211 Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3.
notes: One 2.5G RJ45 only; the second Thunderbolt 4 port can carry a 10G/2.5G Thunderbolt NIC but that adapter is not modelled. Kit model NUC13ANHi7 already exists in the catalogue with wlan0 at 1G - AX211 is a 2x2 160 MHz Wi-Fi 6E part, so 2.5G is the more accurate radio figure.
